notes.title: New (small) Game Released!
notes.content:
Hey guys! I recently made another boomer shooter game and I wanted to share it here for you to play. This was a small project that I made in a week so it has bugs and the quality might be a bit questionable in a few places lol. My next full game is also in progress, join the discord for updates and early playtesting!



[h2][b][url=https://dobrx.itch.io/blood-shot]Play the game here![/url][/b][/h2]

notes.title: Cryptis - Update Notes May 23rd
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added "Ultra Low Spec" option in display settings for low end PCs
[*] Buffed shotgun fire rate and reload speed
[*] Fixed issue with explosive candles not dealing correct amount of damage
[/list]

notes.title: Cryptis - Update Notes May 20th
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Improved enemy AI so they no longer stop moving immediately when they can't reach the player
[*] Nerfed the werewolf's rage mode sprint speed
[*] Fixed bug where enemies could go through the arena walls
[*] Fixed issue where the ground on the second map wasn't properly pixelated
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.2 now out!
notes.content:
[b]Major Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Enemy graphics and behavior overhaul
[*] New music!
[*] New secret weapon and map updates
[*] Improved lighting rendering
[*] New enemy health balancing system
[/list]

[b]Minor Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] New and improved sniper rifle animations
[*] New enemy hit reaction effects
[*] Werewolf enemy new rage mode attack ability
[*] Buffed LMG fire rate, decreased bullet spread and reload time, and increased ammo capacity
[*] Adjusted shotgun and pistol to make them feel more impactful
[*] Improved fog effects
[*] Improved player’s bunny-hop ability
[*] Improved main menu scene
[*] New sword attack camera animations, effects, and increased damage
[*] Updated crosshair and screen effects for certain weapons
[*] Improved ADS responsiveness
[/list]


[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where pixelation filter would turn on even if disabled after the player died
[*] Fixed collision issue on stairs that would cause the player to get stuck in the air above them
[*] Fixed places missing floor
[*] Fixed the Cryptis’ speed not being set correctly on higher difficulties
[*] Fixed certain save locations that would cause the player immediately fall the their death
[*] Fixed issue where not all enemies would spawn when entering an arena
[*] Fixed audio clipping when large amount of enemies spawned in
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1 is here!
notes.content:
[b]Update 1.1 Notes:[/b]

[list]
[b]
Major Changes:[/b]
[*] New intro cutscene
[*] Improved ranged enemy AI
[*] New sword heavy attack ability (Activated with the right mouse button/aim down sights button)
[*] Enemies now have dynamic movement speeds depending on the difficulty
[*] Significantly improved final boss arena
[*] Improved graphics in arenas on the first map


[b]Minor Changes:[/b]
[*] Buffed Pistol by increasing clip size and damage
[*] Buffed LMG by increasing clip size and fire rate
[*] Improved default keybindings
[*] Miscellaneous bug fixes
[*] Improved audio mixing
[*] Improved lantern lighting quality
[*] Fixed performance issue which occurs in certain location on second map
[/list]
